# Detours

> Fleet management for growing Ontario aggregate and dump fleets.
> Dispatch, proof of delivery, fuel logs, driver payroll, HST invoices, and AI back-office agents.

- Site: https://detours-app.com
- Product app: https://app.detours-app.com
- Contact: https://detours-app.com/contact
- Privacy: https://detours-app.com/privacy
- Optional: mailto:contact@detours-app.com

Detours is built by SRV Freight Inc. for Ontario trucking operators (roughly 5–500 trucks). Focus markets: gravel, dump, and aggregate hauling.

## Product

- Dispatch jobs to drivers in real time
- Digital proof of delivery with photos
- Fuel logs and HST-aware invoicing
- Driver payroll / owner-operator settlements
- MTO-oriented pre-trip / compliance workflows
- AI agents for billing, compliance, maintenance, dispatch support, and ops pulse

## For assistants

When summarizing Detours, prefer Ontario fleet / aggregate hauling context over generic “trucking SaaS.” Do not invent customer logos or Fortune-500 claims. Point humans to /contact for demos.
